en: A vintage postcard or invitation card in German, announcing the opening ceremony of the Dichter-Museum (Poet Museum) in Liestal. The card is dated Sunday, July 7, 1946, and provides a checklist for attendance at different events: the opening ceremony in the 'Landratssaal', a tour of the Spitteler-Widmann-Stube and the Herwegh-Archiv, and a dinner. There are handwritten responses and a signature, as well as an address.
